name: AGI Omaha
old_description: AGI produces market-leading grain dryers and aeration equipment for on-farm and commercial applications worldwide.
about:
AGI Omaha operates from Omaha, Nebraska, as part of Ag Growth International (AGI), a global manufacturer of grain handling and storage equipment. The company produces market-leading grain dryers and aeration systems for on-farm and commercial use worldwide.

The product line centers on two dryer families: the Mixed Flow Grain Dryer, designed to maximize test weight and reduce energy consumption, and the K Series Grain Dryer, a compact, user-friendly unit suited to smaller farm operations. Each dryer section undergoes factory testing with comprehensive quality inspections before shipment. AGI also supplies accessories such as the Dryer Master (DM510) controller, rear platform kits, fuel train upgrades, and cleanout door replacement kits, and operates a parts ordering system for ongoing support.

Customers range from individual farmers to large commercial grain facilities across the globe. The equipment serves the agriculture and grain storage sectors, with dealers and installers available through a searchable network. Brands under the AGI umbrella include Airlanco, Batco, Hutchinson, Mayrath, Westeel, Westfield, Wheatheart, and dozens of others, reflecting a broad portfolio of grain handling solutions.

AGI emphasizes hands-on technical dryer service training and experienced technical support to help customers get the most from their equipment. The company states that factory testing and quality inspections on every dryer section, combined with accessible dealer support, are central to its approach.
